data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anasa', meaning to rest, Enisa signifies 'she who gives rest'. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Enisa usually hope their child will grow to embody light, moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
